header.statement: Before G-3's fuzzing runs, each named seed of fuzz/bound_seeds.txt run alone through its fuzz target, built by the fuzz preset at this commit, with fuzz/launch.txt's flags and -max_len and -runs=1, 5 times on each host. A run's time an execution is libFuzzer's time for the whole run of the input, its Executed line, over its count of executed units, 2 where the leak check reran the input; a run passes if it exited 0 with no finding and within the bar, and on Linux with its sibling kept busy at its start and its end; the gate passes if every run of every seed does.
header.assembled: Assembled on 2026-11-26 by scripts/gate_results.py, a script written after the runs, from the raw records of the runs of 2026-11-17: each host's step log and each run's libFuzzer output, and on Linux each run's per-CPU counter copies, wall time and record of its sibling's spinning process. The script that ran the gate and wrote those records is not in the repository. Nothing was timed again.
header.bar: half of fuzz/launch.txt's -timeout=10, in ms an execution

macOS.placement: each run alone under heavy.sh, unpinned, with fuzz/launch.txt's macOS leak options and the build's own kernel set
macOS.kept: the step log's start and end of each run, UTC to the second, its exit code, and its line of figures with the 1-minute load read just before it began; libFuzzer's output. No per-CPU record

Linux.placement: each run alone under heavy.sh, pinned to cpu6 with taskset, at TICK_STORE_SIMD=avx2, with fuzz/launch.txt's Linux leak options, and cpu7, cpu6's SMT sibling, kept busy for the whole run by a spinning process started a second before it
Linux.kept: as on macOS, and the kernel's per-CPU counters copied before and after the run, which give each cpu's busy share over it and the processes started during it; its wall time; and whether the spinning process was running at its start and at its end
